sentences.en: My brother-in-law is ready to lose his temper at trifles.
sentences.zh: 我的大伯子/小叔子一遇到小事就容易发脾气。

sentences.en: My brother-in-law would like me to be his son's godfather.
sentences.zh: 我的大伯子/小叔子希望我做他儿子的教父。

sentences.en: I asked my brother-in-law to come with me to Kabylie.
sentences.zh: 我请我的大伯子/小叔子陪我去卡比利亚。

senses.zh: 姐夫；妹夫；内弟；内兄；小叔；大伯；堂兄弟；表兄弟
